comparison.recommendation: In this Python proxy comparison, the Laplace-LK baseline scored P50 0.0239 ms vs hybrid all-MiniLM-L6-v2 P50 7.1991 ms (~301.2x slower in Python, +133.63 MB peak process RSS delta after PyTorch/Transformers imports). On this synthetic corpus at fixed threshold 5.0 nats (semantic_weight=12), disguised-semantic recall changed by +0.6667 (0.3333 -> 1.0000) with FP delta +0 (0 -> 0). Because neural embedding inference measured 7.1991 ms P50 latency and +133.63 MB post-import peak process RSS overhead in this benchmark, semantic embeddings remain optional for sidecar or offline evaluation rather than embedded in the zero-dependency Go binary.
